question: Choose the antonym of 'tangible':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tangible"** refers to something that can be touched, felt, or perceived physically; it is real and concrete. (स्पृश्य, ठोस)

 
 
• **Example:** The evidence presented in court was tangible and could not be ignored.
 
 
 
• **"Intangible" **is the opposite of tangible. It refers to something that cannot be touched or physically perceived, often related to abstract ideas or qualities. (अमूर्त)
 
 
• **Example: **Love and trust are intangible qualities that are vital in any relationship.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'tangible'** is **'intangible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Invisible **(अदृश्य): Something that cannot be seen with the naked eye.

 
 
• **Example:** The virus is invisible to the human eye but can cause serious illnesses.
 
 
 
• **Real **(वास्तविक): Something that exists in reality and is not imaginary.
 
 
• **Example:** The fear of failure is very real for many people.
 
 
 
• **Definite **(निश्चित): Something that is clearly defined or certain.
 
 
• **Example:** We need a definite plan to execute this project successfully.
 
 

84:Tb99,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.<
